title: Nimitz Tic Tac acceleration and power estimates

tellings.quote: in the case of the Nimtt, we estimate the acceleration of the Tic Tac falling from 28,000 feet to sea level at 7.5 seconds or so, 78 seconds.

plain: In 2004, off Southern California, near the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz, a white oval object shaped like a Tic Tac mint is said to have dropped from 28,000 feet to sea level in a fraction of a second. A researcher named Kevin Knuth gives his team's estimate, garbled in speech as "7.5 seconds or so, 78 seconds", without naming a source. He uses the figure to work out how fast the object sped up and how much power that would take, far beyond any known aircraft.
